description:
FOUND s438 (Opus 5) in the #473 cpan-t census population
(cpan-tests/modules/Test-Simple-1.302199/t/Test2/modules/API/InterceptResult.t:95).

REPRO, and the discriminator is the METHOD NAME alone:

  package S; sub new { bless {}, shift } sub thing { { count => 2 } }
  package main;
  sub is_deeply { print "ok\n" }
  my $one = S->new;
  is_deeply( $one->thing, { count => 2, failed => 1 }, "desc" );   # lowers, runs

  ... with `sub state` and `$one->state` instead:  statement DROPPED,
      "Can't call method \"content\" on an undefined value"

So the `state` KEYWORD path is entered for a token that is a method name.  A
compiler internal error (a call to ->content on undef) is the loud half of
CLAUDE.md rule 12: it announces, but it announces the wrong thing -- the
message names PPI's API, not the construct.

RELATED, do not duplicate: #481 is the same "a Word after -> is a METHOD NAME"
fact in the autoquote pass, and the s407 review fix is the same fact in the
term walker.  Three sites now; look for ONE upstream place (CLAUDE.md 11's
"count the parse paths") before patching the keyword branch in place.

BAR: a Pl/t row for `->state`, `->my`, `->print` (perl allows any keyword as a
method name); census row for InterceptResult.t leaves by EDIT.

DONE s456ag (Opus agent AG, round 13) -- see #481 for the shared record: the
task's suspicion was right, #481 and #482 are ONE fact ("a WORD after `->` is a
METHOD NAME") in two passes, and the fix is ONE predicate,
`Pl::PExpr::_word_is_method_name`, asked by both.

The #482 half: `extract_declarations` (Pl/PExpr.pm) matched
`^(?:CORE::)?(my|our|state|local)$` on any Word and SKIPPED it as a declarator,
so `$one->state` lost the word and the postfix-`->` handler ran with `$nxt`
undef -- `Can't call method "content" on an undefined value`, PPI's API named
instead of the construct.  The loop is now indexed so the position is available
to the predicate.

Probed vs perl 5.40.3: `->state`, `->my`, `->our`, `->local`, `->print`, a
keyword method name mid-chain, all with and without a following fat comma, and
the negatives (`state $n = 0` in a sub body, `my`/`our`/`local` declarations,
keyword-shaped hash KEYS `state => 10`) -- 16 rows, identical.

CENSUS: Test2/API/InterceptResult/Event.pm (1 drop) removed entirely; the
`Can't call method "content"` half of
t/Test2/modules/API/InterceptResult.t removed (its other drop was the
block-form `->` boundary, fixed in the same session).  The board's
Test2::Util::Grabber (`!$hub->state->ended`) also stops dropping.
Guard Pl/t/method-name-word-01.t.
subject: A method named after a perl KEYWORD dies in the compiler: `$obj->state` raises "Can't call method \"content\" on an undefined value" and drops the statement
